races.name: Find Us At fitzdares.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o MYTHOLOGICAL STAR stands out as a progressive sort in this line-up and is taken to make light of a 6 lb penalty for last week's Ffos Las success. Post Rider has been given a chance by the handicapper and it wouldn't be a surprise to see her bounce back to form and provide the chief threat.

  1. MYTHOLOGICAL STAR (IRE)
  2. POST RIDER
  3. GOLDEN CIRCET (IRE)

races.name: Fitzdares Nursery
races.verdict:
HARRY KNOWS shot clear in a C&D novice under Oisin Murphy last month and may be able to give the weight away. Fellow last-time-out C&D scorer Keep Kicking On is feared most ahead of This Moment.

  1. HARRY KNOWS (IRE)
  2. KEEP KICKING ON (IRE)
  3. THIS MOMENT (IRE)

races.name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This should concern the previous winners, with REAL BULLET fancied to make it 2-2 at the expense of Wateera.

  1. REAL BULLET
  2. WATEERA (IRE)
  3. GOLDTRADER

races.name: Fitzdares Sprint Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
TREFOR goes well round here and can bounce back off a handy-looking mark to go one better than when runner-up in this event 12 months ago. C&D scorer Badri (third last year) is thriving this season and rates a major threat in his bid for a four-timer, though. Recent C&D 1-2 Another Abbot and Sudden Flight can also play a prominent role in this very competitive sprint.

  1. TREFOR (IRE)
  2. BADRI
  3. ANOTHER ABBOT (IRE)

races.name: Fitzdares Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for PRINCESS HONEY BEE to get off the mark. If there's one to spoil the party, it'll most likely be Somethingintheair.

  1. PRINCESS HONEY BEE
  2. SOMETHINGINTHEAIR
  3. STERLING FORTUNE

races.name: Listen To Track Radio Live Handicap
races.verdict:
CRECIENTE probably should have won at Lingfield last week and can make amends from the same mark with Oisin Murphy back in the saddle. My Old Mate had a bit to spare over C&D last time and is the obvious danger. Karisma's Angel may prove best of the remainder.

  1. CRECIENTE
  2. MY OLD MATE (IRE)
  3. KARISMA'S ANGEL

races.name: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting will offer plenty of clues but TIKKA has plenty going for her on paper, and she could be the answer in a tricky race to assess. Nouva Stella, Rhythm of My Heart, Isabella of Aragon, Hidden Beyond and Greta Tintin are other likely types.

  1. TIKKA
  2. NOUVA STELLA
  3. RHYTHM OF MY HEART

races.name: Unibet/EBF Newcomers' 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
No form to go on but it could pay to side with Eve Johnson Houghton's Time Test filly THESPIAN QUEEN to make a winning start. Andrew Balding's daughter of Calyx Tojoannie could emerge as the main danger ahead of Tredegar Square and Celtic Storm in a race where the market can prove highly informative.

  1. THESPIAN QUEEN
  2. TOJOANNIE
  3. TREDEGAR SQUARE

races.name: Bet 20 Get 20 With Unibet Nursery
races.verdict:
MAGICAL LIFE rates the pick of the weights on the back of an improved Ffos Las third so could prove the answer to this trappy nursery. Richard Hannon's handicap debutant Lady Miranda appeals as the main danger ahead of Lushill and Ten of Clubs.

  1. MAGICAL LIFE
  2. LADY MIRANDA
  3. LUSHILL (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
FALLACIOUS PROMISE is fancied to quickly resume winning ways on the back of an unlucky-in-running second over C&D last time. Ballybunion looks to have more to offer and is feared most on his first go on polytrack, ahead of Roi de Coeur and Shadowmere.

  1. FALLACIOUS PROMISE
  2. BALLYBUNION (IRE)
  3. ROI DE COEUR (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but the vote goes to MOHAAB, who comes here at the top of her game and can gain a second success. Fellow in-form filly Shirakawa heads the list of dangers, although both Ghost Story and Hot Silk can play a prominent role too.

  1. MOHAAB
  2. SHIRAKAWA
  3. GHOST STORY (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances in a cracking handicap but it could prove worth siding with Hughie Morrison's PREMIERE LIGNE who has steadily returned to form after a long absence and caught the eye when a strong-travelling seventh in the Northumberland Vase last time out. Hat-trick seeking Senor Cortez could emerge as the main danger, although Desert Belle and Believitanducan can play a prominent role too.

  1. PREMIERE LIGNE (FR)
  2. SENOR CORTEZ (IRE)
  3. DESERT BELLE

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet 5 Get 30 New Customer Offer' EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
William Haggas usually strikes with runners in maidens here, so it'll probably pay to side with NEXT OF KIN following her promising debut. Desert Smoke is the main danger if back to the form she showed at Newmarket first time up. A case can also be made for Irish raider Fly Smartly, especially if supported.

  1. NEXT OF KIN
  2. DESERT SMOKE
  3. FLY SMARTLY (IRE)

races.name: 'Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder' Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
Preference is HOSTELRY, who continues to operate at a level below what she was capable of in 2025 but a drop to classified company combined with a first-time visor could well spark a revival. Millbuie was helped by having the run of the race when runner-up at Newcastle recently, but he rates as the main danger with a repeat, with Bridgefoot Rambler rounding off the shortlist.

  1. HOSTELRY
  2. MILLBUIE
  3. BRIDGEFOOT RAMBLER

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Big Daily Boosts On Racing' Handicap
races.verdict:
The Linda Perratt yard is in flying form so KEEP ME STABLE gets the nod to build on his good runner-up effort at Musselburgh on Friday. Carmel Valley has fared better since being ridden from the front and is feared most ahead of Albeyours, who promises to be suited by the drop back to 7f.

  1. KEEP ME STABLE (IRE)
  2. CARMEL VALLEY (IRE)
  3. ALBEYOURS

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get More With Ladbucks' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
STAR CAST thrived in the first half of the year, culminating with a comfortable win over C&D, and is taken to pick up where she left off back from a short break. Unexposed William Haggas 3-y-o Lorca's Waltz heads the dangers, along with Obito.

  1. STAR CAST
  2. LORCA'S WALTZ
  3. OBITO (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Insure Your Acca On Football' Handicap
races.verdict:
VELVET SKIES may be able to go one better than on stable debut last month. Water of Leith is a previous winner of this race and could be worth another chance eased in grade. Ski Angel and White Umbrella are a couple to consider at bigger prices.

  1. VELVET SKIES (IRE)
  2. WATER OF LEITH (IRE)
  3. SKI ANGEL

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LESRICO ran up to best when runner-up at Haydock on reappearance and provided he's able to put a lesser effort behind him since, Lisa Williamson's 6-y-o can double his career tally back down in grade. Heading up the opposition is Recobella, who opened her handicap account over C&D last month, with Naturalia and Penelope's Sister taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. LESRICO
  2. RECOBELLA (FR)
  3. NATURALIA

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several and at the likely prices it may well be worth siding with MOTAWAARED, who has left the impression he's building up to something on plenty of starts for this yard and may have needed his latest fifth over C&D following a breathing operation. Royal Blaze remains of major interest arriving on a C&D hat-trick, so he heads up the dangers, with Sweet Kiss and West Tyrone both considered, too.

  1. MOTAWAARED
  2. ROYAL BLAZE
  3. SWEET KISS

races.name: 'Ladbrokes Play 1-2-Free' Handicap
races.verdict:
This can go the way of PARODA DIVA, who has responded well to the refitting of cheekpieces and Patrick Neville's filly can add a third career success to her tally at the expense of Keep An Eye On It, who progressed again stepped up to 1m when third at Musselburgh back in April and it's unlikely we've seen all he has to offer. Vega Storm and Hatamoto looks best of the remainder.

  1. PARODA DIVA (IRE)
  2. KEEP AN EYE ON IT
  3. VEGA STORM (IRE)

races.name: C.J. Sheeran Ltd 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MINELLA BUOY and No Bother Aoife shaped well starting out in this sphere at Killarney last month and look the pair to focus on, with John Nallen's charge taken to confirm that form and open his account. Mount Eden should have more to offer in a truly-run race, while Nod of Approval is certainly bred for the job for his top connections.

  1. MINELLA BUOY
  2. NO BOTHER AOIFE (IRE)
  3. MOUNT EDEN (IRE)

races.name: Bank Of Ireland Brendan Maloney Memorial Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOW'S ELLIE made a much better fist of it on her second go over hurdles here 3 weeks ago and can do better still as she gains experience. She looks the way to go in a thin maiden hurdle. Texas Red and Crystal Mariner are a couple of the other likely players.

  1. HOW'S ELLIE (IRE)
  2. TEXAS RED (FR)
  3. CRYSTAL MARINER (IRE)

races.name: Cummins Homevalue Hardware Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHEMDAWG returns to hurdling on the back of a very good Flat second at Limerick and could well have the run of thisso is fancied to double her hurdles tally. The less-exposed Koeur A Prendre looks to have more to offer and rates a big threat though, while Theanniversary Man and Ripsnorter could also have a say.

  1. CHEMDAWG (IRE)
  2. KOEUR A PRENDRE (FR)
  3. THEANNIVERSARY MAN (IRE)

races.name: Broderick's Electric Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
In an open-looking handicap, COOL SUMMER's recent form just gives her the edge over C&D winner The Vegas Raider and the returning Let Him B.

  1. COOL SUMMER (IRE)
  2. THE VEGAS RAIDER (IRE)
  3. LET HIM B (IRE)

races.name: Burleigh Accountancy Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DOWN AROUND hasn't been long with Gordon Elliott, and he's fancied to capitalise on a handy mark. Dorans Law won this corresponding event in 2024 and is weighted to go close again, while last year's runner-up Ladiam also needs considering.

  1. DOWN AROUND (IRE)
  2. DORANS LAW (IRE)
  3. LADIAM (IRE)

races.name: Bay Leaf Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
KEEP EM QUITE achieved fair form when fifth in a Wexford handicap last time and might prove the answer to this maiden. Gordon Elliott's Western Shores could pose a threat if a first-time tongue tie helps her to recapture the level of her first 2 starts. Gainsville, another with a leading yard, showed a bit of promise last time and also makes the shortlist.

  1. KEEP EM QUITE (IRE)
  2. WESTERN SHORES (IRE)
  3. GAINSVILLE (IRE)

races.name: Tim Kelly Group Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
PILGRIMS WALK could have more to offer on the back of his improved handicap debut second at Kilbeggan and gets the nod ahead of Cornaroya Rocco, who, like the selection, posted her best effort when runner-up last time. Moonshine Girl and Ranger Billy are others likely to have a say.

  1. PILGRIMS WALK (IRE)
  2. CORNAROYA ROCCO (IRE)
  3. MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE)
